chapter: Gastrointestinal / esophageal, gastric, small bowel, colonic and hereditary GI disorders

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Eosinophilic esophagitis
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Atopy, solid-food dysphagia/impaction; >=15 eos/hpf on multiple biopsies; PPI, swallowed steroids, elimination diet, selected dupilumab, dilation with anti-inflammatory care.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Achalasia
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Degeneration of inhibitory esophageal myenteric neurons; dysphagia to solids and liquids; Chicago-classified manometry; POEM, pneumatic dilation or Heller myotomy.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Zenker diverticulum
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Pharyngoesophageal pulsion pseudodiverticulum from cricopharyngeal dysfunction; regurgitation of old food, aspiration; endoscopic or surgical septotomy.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Boerhaave syndrome
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Full-thickness esophageal rupture after emesis; CT water-soluble contrast, urgent antibiotics/resuscitation/drainage and expert-directed repair or endoscopic closure.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Autoimmune metaplastic atrophic gastritis
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Parietal-cell autoimmune body/fundus gland destruction; gastrin elevation, iron/B12 deficiency, intestinal metaplasia, type 1 gastric NET risk; replenish deficits, risk-stratified surveillance.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Gastric intestinal metaplasia
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Replacement of gastric epithelium by intestinal phenotype, variable precancer risk; H pylori eradication and MAPS III risk-based surveillance according to extent and comorbidity.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Ménétrier disease
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Hypertrophic foveolar epithelium, gland atrophy and protein-losing gastropathy with giant rugal folds; supportive therapy, causative infections when present, selected cetuximab or surgery.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Zollinger–Ellison syndrome
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Gastrinoma causing inappropriate gastric hyperacidity/refractory ulcers, secretory diarrhea; differentiate PPI-induced hypergastrinemia; PPI and tumour-directed therapy.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Lymphocytic microscopic colitis
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Chronic watery nonbloody diarrhea with normal endoscopic appearance; >=20 intraepithelial lymphocytes per 100 surface epithelial cells; budesonide when indicated.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Collagenous microscopic colitis
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Watery nonbloody diarrhea; thickened subepithelial collagen table (>10 micrometers) and inflammation; budesonide, remove implicated medications where appropriate.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Clostridioides difficile colitis
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Antibiotic-associated toxin-mediated colitis, possible volcano lesions/pseudomembranes; symptomatic testing, fidaxomicin or oral vancomycin depending on context, urgent care for fulminant disease.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Ischemic colitis
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Colonic perfusion injury usually at vulnerable watershed segments; acute pain then hematochezia, CT/endoscopic findings; supportive care or surgery for necrosis/peritonitis.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Whipple disease
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Tropheryma whipplei systemic infection; malabsorption, arthritis, PAS-positive macrophages, PCR confirmation; extended CNS-penetrant antimicrobial regimen based on expert guidance.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Small-bowel microbial overgrowth often secondary to motility/anatomic disease; selected breath testing, underlying-cause correction, selective antibiotics, nutritional support.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Hirschsprung disease
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Congenital distal aganglionosis, absent RAIR with rectal biopsy confirmation; enterocolitis may be life-threatening; surgical pull-through.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Familial adenomatous polyposis
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Pathogenic APC/Wnt dysregulation with hundreds-thousands of colorectal adenomas; germline confirmation and surveillance, preventive colectomy according to risk, upper GI surveillance.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Lynch syndrome
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Hereditary mismatch-repair gene pathogenic variant causing colorectal/endometrial and other cancer predisposition; tumour IHC/MSI screens but germline testing confirms; risk-based surveillance and prevention.

medical_profiles_condensed.name: Chronic intestinal pseudo-obstruction
medical_profiles_condensed.medical_summary: Severe gut propulsion failure without a mechanical lesion; image/endoscopic exclusion of fixed blockage, assess myopathic, neuropathic and systemic etiologies; nutrition and specialized motility care.
